abrazar: to embrace; to take up (a course)
acto: act; moment (en el acto: at once)
alcance: reach; scope (dar alcance: to catch up)
aras: altars (en aras de: for the sake of)
asegurarse: to make sure; to secure oneself
cabia: fell to (le cabía: it fell to him)
comunicarle: to communicate to him, impart to him
contar: to count; to tell; to rely (contar con)
dejarle: to leave him; to let him
desprenderse: to let go of, give up
dirigirse: to make one's way; to address
echar: to cast; to put (armas al hombro)
entiende: is understood (se entiende conmigo: applies to me)
escapado: escaped (se le habían escapado: had slipped out)
exponerle: to put to him, explain to him
frente: front (al frente de: at the head of)
hacerle: to make him; to do to him
hacerse: to make oneself; to be done
hacía: made, caused (se hacía cubrir: was made to cover)
humo: smoke (humo de la gloria: heady fumes of glory)
montando: mounting (montando en ira: flying into a rage)
placer: pleasure; will (a placer de: at the will of)
ponerse: to put oneself; to set about
rato: while (por largo rato: for a long while)
rosa: Santa-Rosa: a place (casa de ejercicios de Santa-Rosa)
v: V.: in the abbreviation V. E. (Vuestra Excelencia)
valer: to be worth (hacer valer: to assert)
verse: to see oneself; to be seen
virtud: virtue (a virtud de: by virtue of)
vista: sight; view (en vista de: in view of)
